item.title: Middleton Made Knives Black Artisan Market Returns for Second Year
item.description: Quintin Middleton announced the return of the Middleton Made Knives Black Artisan Market for its second year. The event will take place on Saturday, Feb. 21, 2026, from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m., once again at the Charleston Navy Yard.

item.title: The Dee Norton Child Advocacy Center’s 26th Annual Hope Grows Here Dinner Auction
item.description: Dee Norton Child Advocacy Center, the region’s leading resource for preventing abuse, protecting children and healing families, invites the community to participate in the 26th annual Hope Grows Here Dinner Auction.

item.title: Ocean Blue at The Ellie Beach Resort to Offer Valentine’s Day Dinner With Ocean Views
item.description: Ocean Blue, the signature oceanfront restaurant at The Ellie Beach Resort, will offer a special Valentine’s Day dinner Saturday, Feb. 14, featuring a flexible à la carte menu designed to let couples create their own ideal evening.

item.title: Quintin’s Close-Ups: Jazz Singer and Violist Alva Anderson
item.description: Quintin Washington of Quintin's Close-Ups recently spoke with a Charleston news maker. You can watch the interview below.

item.title: Maynard Nexsen’s Atlanta Office Adds Financial Services Litigator
item.description: Maynard Nexsen, a full-service law firm with 31 offices nationwide, welcomes Leo Kogan to its Atlanta location. He joins the firm’s seasoned group of attorneys with extensive experience across all facets of litigation and regulatory matters.

item.title: Charleston Parks Conservancy Names New Members to Board of Directors
item.description: The Charleston Parks Conservancy, dedicated to caring for and enhancing 26 parks, gardens, and trails across Charleston, announces the appointment of new members to its Board of Directors.

item.title: Warming Centers Opening Jan. 15-16 Due to Cold Weather
item.description: Due to forecasted cold weather, several Warming Centers will open on Thursday, January 15, 2026, and Friday, January 16, 2026, to provide a safe, heated place for individuals and families in need.

item.title: Coastal Community Foundation Announces New Vice President of Philanthropy
item.description: Coastal Community Foundation (CCF) is pleased to announce Dana Taylor as the new Vice President of Philanthropy.

item.title: Katie Wagner Promoted to Senior Consultant at Knowledge Capital Group
item.description: Knowledge Capital Group [KCG], is pleased to announce the promotion of Katie Wagner to Senior Consultant.

item.title: Enjoy Free Delivery from Grimaldi’s Pizzeria for National Pizza Week
item.description: Grimaldi’s Pizzeria is inviting guests to extend National Pizza Week indulgence throughout January with free delivery on online orders.
